title: Webflow Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

description:

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Video Content Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Content Intern em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: Internship, 6 hours/day (30 hours/week)

Compensation: R$2,000/month

About the Role

We're an early-stage stealth startup in the health and wellness space, building our brand from the ground up. We're looking for a creative, fast-moving video intern who can turn raw footage and ideas into scroll-stopping short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and ads. You'll work directly with the founder and play a key role in how our brand shows up on video. Great opportunity for someone early in their career who loves editing and wants real ownership over content that thousands of people will see.

What You'll Do

  • Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid ads (15-60 second formats)
  • Turn influencer footage, raw clips, and simple briefs into polished, platform-ready videos
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and light motion to make content engaging
  • Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats and cuts
  • Format and optimize videos to spec for each platform
  • Help maintain an organized library of footage and assets
  • Occasionally create simple graphics or thumbnails to support video content

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. The interview will be conducted in English.
  • Strong editing skills in CapCut, and/or CapCut, Premiere, or similar (essential)
  • A real sense for what makes short-form video engaging, hooks, pacing, retention
  • Fast turnaround, comfortable producing multiple edits per day
  • Organized and reliable with deadlines
  • Self-motivated; you'll get briefs and direction, but we want someone who brings ideas
  • Available 6 hours per day

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing for health, wellness, fitness, or DTC/e-commerce brands
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills
  • An eye for trends, you watch a lot of TikTok and know what's working right now

What You'll Get

  • Real, hands-on experience producing content for a brand from day one
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Flexible remote work
  • Room to grow into a larger creative role as the company scales


How to Apply

In your resume, add a link to a reel or portfolio of your video work, ideally short-form social content you've edited.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

description:

Fonoaudiólogo(a) | Saúde Auditiva e Reabilitação Auditiva

Salvador/BA | Presencial | CLT


Mais do que reabilitar, nós devolvemos conexões. ✨


Na Sonora Centro Auditivo, acreditamos que ouvir bem é viver melhor.

Todos os dias ajudamos pessoas a voltarem a participar das conversas em família, recuperarem sua autonomia e reconquistarem a confiança para se comunicar.

Se você é Fonoaudiólogo(a), tem paixão por cuidar de pessoas e deseja atuar em uma empresa referência em saúde auditiva, queremos conhecer você.


Sobre a Sonora

Com 29 anos de experiência, a Sonora Centro Auditivo é referência em saúde auditiva na Bahia, oferecendo atendimento humanizado, tecnologia de ponta e acompanhamento contínuo aos pacientes.

Nossa missão é transformar vidas por meio da audição, devolvendo às pessoas a conexão com quem amam e mais qualidade de vida.

  • Contribuir para o alcance das metas da unidade através de um atendimento de excelência.

    • O que buscamos

    • Graduação completa em Fonoaudiologia;
    • Experiência com adaptação e acompanhamento de aparelhos auditivos;
    • Boa comunicação e facilidade de relacionamento;
    • Perfil consultivo, proativo e orientado para resultados;
    • Interesse em desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.


    Remuneração e Benefícios

    Salário fixo inicial: R$ 5.000,00

    Salário após período de experiência: R$ 5.500,00

    Remuneração fixa + variável por desempenho, com potencial de ganhos acima de R$ 10.000,00/mês

    Premiação por alcance de metas e resultados

    ✅ Vale-alimentação

    ✅ Vale-transporte

    ✅ Contratação CLT



    Informações da vaga

    Barra, Salvador/BA

    Segunda a sexta-feira | 08h às 17h

    Atuação presencial



    Por que trabalhar na Sonora?

    ✔ Empresa consolidada e reconhecida no mercado

    ✔ Tecnologia auditiva de referência mundial

    ✔ Atendimento humanizado e foco na experiência do paciente

    ✔ Ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor

    ✔ Desenvolvimento técnico e comercial

    ✔ Oportunidade real de crescimento profissional e financeiro

    Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que transforma vidas todos os dias através da audição.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional.

O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs);
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior ou pós-graduação em Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Vivência na definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e indicadores de performance;
  • Experiência em ambientes de TI, com interface entre áreas técnicas, operações e dados;
  • Capacidade de atuação tanto em nível estratégico quanto no detalhamento conceitual de indicadores;
  • Experiência com stakeholders e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência em ambientes de Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) ou operações de serviços de TI;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.);
  • Experiência em Data & Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de gestão de serviços (ITIL) e governança (COBIT);
  • Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou de grande porte.


Diferenciais do perfil

  • Experiência prévia na estruturação de indicadores corporativos de TI;
  • Atuação em governança de métricas de performance e eficiência operacional;
  • Capacidade de conectar dados técnicos com impacto de negócio;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua.



Sobre a empresa

Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno

logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m

arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno

logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional


growth.

Somos uma plataforma completa para o universo de eventos: venda de ingressos online e PDV, controle de acesso (QrCode e reconhecimento facial), credenciamento, sistema de bar e gestão de consumo cashless, totens de autoatendimento e cardápio virtual.

totalingressos.com


A vaga: Consultor(a) Comercial / Representante de Vendas

Buscamos pessoas com espírito empreendedor, rede de relacionamento no mercado de eventos e fome de resultado para atuar como Parceiro(a) Comercial da Total Ingressos.

Sua missão será prospectar, apresentar e fechar contratos com produtores de eventos, casas noturnas, organizadores de festivais, rodeios, exposições, congressos, eventos esportivos e culturais — e ganhar comissão sobre tudo que entrar pela sua mão , durante toda a vida útil do cliente.


O que você vai fazer

  • Prospectar produtores e organizadores de eventos (ativo e por indicação)
  • Apresentar nossa solução completa: ingressos online, PDV, controle de acesso, credenciamento, sistema de bar, cashless, pulseiras e estacionamento
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais (presenciais ou online) e elaborar propostas com nosso suporte
  • Negociar e fechar contratos seguindo nosso SLA de vendas
  • Acompanhar o cliente do fechamento à entrega, garantindo recorrência
  • Identificar oportunidades de upsell (sistema de bar, credenciamento, pulseiras, totens, etc.)


Perfil que procuramos

  • Experiência ou rede de contatos em eventos, entretenimento, ticketing, casas noturnas, rodeios, festivais ou produção cultural (diferencial forte)
  • Perfil caçador : gosta de prospecção, não tem medo do \"não\" e celebra cada fechamento
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, postura comercial consultiva
  • Organização para registrar leads, eventos e contratos no nosso CRM/formulários
  • Autonomia e disciplina para trabalhar remotamente, sem chefe te cobrando todo dia
  • CNPJ ativo (MEI ou ME) ou disposição para abrir — formalizamos a parceria como PJ


Como você ganha (modelo de remuneração)

Trabalhamos com modelo de parceria comercial — sem salário fixo, 100% variável, sem teto e com recorrência . Você é remunerado pelo sucesso que gera.


- Comissão recorrente sobre vendas online (site)

  • % de cashback sobre o faturamento total das vendas online de cada evento que você trouxer
  • Recebe toda vez que aquele cliente fizer um evento conosco — não é venda única, é recorrência

- Comissão sobre serviços faturados

  • Alta % sobre o valor dos serviços prestados em fatura: ingressos impressos, cortesias, pulseiras, sistema de bar, credenciamento, controle de acesso, totens etc.


- Comissão sobre sistema de bar e cashless

  • Operações de bar (caixas, máquinas SmartPOS, cashless, totens) entram no cálculo da sua comissão recorrente — e esse é um mercado que vem crescendo muito


- Bônus por performance

  • Campanhas trimestrais e bônus de performance para top performers
  • Programa de aceleração para quem trouxer eventos de grande porte (acima de 5 mil ingressos ou contratos com recorrência mensal)

- Comissão por indicação

  • Indicou um produtor que fechou? Você ganha mesmo sem conduzir o processo todo


Exemplo prático: Um festival que vende ingressos online no site, com taxa, gera receita. Você recebe comissão de cashback sobre o faturamento bruto. Se for evento recorrente (anual), você recebe todo ano , sem precisar prospectar de novo.


O que oferecemos para você vender

  • Plataforma robusta, com 16+ anos de mercado e milhares de eventos realizados
  • Materiais comerciais prontos: apresentações, vídeos, fotos e cases de sucesso
  • Modelos de propostas e contratos por tipo de evento (com e sem advance/cachê)
  • Suporte técnico e operacional pré e pós-venda
  • Time de atendimento que te ajuda a fechar
  • Treinamento sobre produtos, precificação e SLA de vendas
  • Liberdade total de horário e local — você gerencia sua rotina

Formato da contratação

  • Parceria comercial PJ (autônomo com CNPJ)
  • Sem vínculo empregatício, sem CLT, sem exclusividade obrigatória de jornada
  • Contrato formal com cláusulas claras de comissionamento, confidencialidade e não concorrência
  • Pagamento das comissões em até 30 dias após o recebimento dos valores pela Total Ingressos
  • Você emite NF dos seus serviços para a Total Ingressos


Como se candidatar

Se você se identificou e quer transformar sua rede de relacionamento e seu talento comercial em renda recorrente e ilimitada , queremos te conhecer.


Envie:

  • Seu currículo ou perfil do LinkedIn
  • Um breve resumo (3-5 linhas) sobre sua experiência com eventos, vendas ou ticketing
  • Cidade/região onde atua e principais contatos do mercado


Bora fazer evento dar dinheiro junto?

Se você já trabalha com eventos, conhece produtores, vive de network ou simplesmente tem um perfil comercial fora da curva e quer escalar sua renda sem teto — essa vaga é sua .


Aplique. Comente \"tenho interesse\". Me chame na DM. O primeiro passo é seu.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM) $6 - $6/hourpayRequired Skills IMUAttention to DetailVideo CaptureAbout micro1 micro1 is the leading AI data lab for training frontier models and evaluating AI agents. Experts contribute their diverse subject matter knowledge across domains such as finance, healthcare, STEM engineering, and more. micro1 transforms that real-world expertise into high-quality training data, evaluations, and feedback loops that improve how AI systems learn, reason, and perform.

Our platform identifies and vets top talent through an AI recruiter, enabling high-quality expert contributions at scale. We aim to enable 1 billion people to do meaningful work by applying their expertise to AI. As our global expert network grows, micro1 is building the human intelligence layer for frontier AI.

Job Description

Job Title: Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM)

Job Type : Contractor | Remote

Eligible Locations : Mexico, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Uruguay, Jamaica, Bahamas, and Barbados.



About the Role

We’re looking for remote contributors to help support the development of next-generation AI and robotics systems through smartphone-based video and motion data collection.

This is a flexible, paid remote opportunity where you’ll record simple real-world activities using your smartphone while following clear recording guidelines.

No advanced technical background is required, but attention to detail and consistency are important.


What You’ll Do

  • Record short videos of physical activities using your smartphone
  • Capture synchronized motion and video data during recording sessions
  • Follow simple step-by-step recording instructions and quality guidelines
  • Submit a minimum of 10 hours of approved video data per week
  • Communicate with the team regarding recording quality or task instructions
  • Complete a quick onboarding and device compatibility check

Requirements

  • Access to a compatible smartphone:
  • iPhone 11 or newer
  • Google Pixel 6 or newer
  • Samsung Galaxy S21 or newer
  • Ability to use a smartphone head strap for hands-free recording within 48 hours of onboarding
  • Comfortable performing repetitive movement-based recording tasks
  • Reliable internet connection and communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured instructions
  • Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.


Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .


Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.


Equipment Requirements

Mobile:

Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.


Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

title: Remote Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM) $6 - $6/hourpayRequired Skills attention to detaildata annotationhousehold tasksvideo recordingAbout micro1 micro1 is the leading AI data lab for training frontier models and evaluating AI agents. Experts contribute their diverse subject matter knowledge across domains such as finance, healthcare, STEM engineering, and more. micro1 transforms that real-world expertise into high-quality training data, evaluations, and feedback loops that improve how AI systems learn, reason, and perform.

Our platform identifies and vets top talent through an AI recruiter, enabling high-quality expert contributions at scale. We aim to enable 1 billion people to do meaningful work by applying their expertise to AI. As our global expert network grows, micro1 is building the human intelligence layer for frontier AI.

Job Description

Job Title: Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM)


Job Type: Contractor


Location: Remote - experts based in Latin America and the Caribbean. Selected countries include:

Mexico, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Uruguay, Jamaica, Bahamas, and Barbados


Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Capture precise motion data using your smartphone’s IMU sensors during specified physical activities.
  • Record synchronized video footage to ensure data accuracy and enhance the integrity of all collected motion data.
  • Follow detailed technical protocols to consistently meet strict quality, labeling, and determinism standards.
  • Deliver a minimum of 10 hours of high-quality, approved video data each week throughout the project’s duration.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with the team to clarify requirements and share insights on data collection practices.
  • Maintain timely and reliable delivery of your outputs, aligned with project milestones and expectations.
  • Participate in device compatibility checks and an innovative, AI-enabled interview process as part of onboarding.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Access to a head strap to be able to record both hands within 48 hours of the start date.
  • Supported devices include the iPhone 12 and later, Google Pixel 6 and later, and Samsung Galaxy S21 and later.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a proven record of following standardized protocols.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently manage output and meet deadlines in a dynamic, data-driven environment.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills essential for documentation and remote collaboration.
  • Advanced tech-savviness and experience with mobile devices for sensor and video data capture.
  • Physical ability to engage in repetitive movement tasks safely and effectively.
  • Access to a compatible smartphone capable of high-fidelity data collection.
  • Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in robotics, kinesiology, sensor-based data collection, or related technical disciplines.
  • Experience with human motion analysis, activity segmentation, or machine learning dataset labeling.
  • Familiarity with structuring large-scale datasets for AI and robotics applications.



Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .


Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.


Equipment Requirements

Mobile:

Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.


Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.

  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.

  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.

  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.

Somos uma plataforma completa para o universo de eventos: venda de ingressos online e PDV, controle de acesso (QrCode e reconhecimento facial), credenciamento, sistema de bar e gestão de consumo cashless, totens de autoatendimento e cardápio virtual.

totalingressos.com


A vaga: Consultor(a) Comercial / Representante de Vendas

Buscamos pessoas com espírito empreendedor, rede de relacionamento no mercado de eventos e fome de resultado para atuar como Parceiro(a) Comercial da Total Ingressos.

Sua missão será prospectar, apresentar e fechar contratos com produtores de eventos, casas noturnas, organizadores de festivais, rodeios, exposições, congressos, eventos esportivos e culturais — e ganhar comissão sobre tudo que entrar pela sua mão , durante toda a vida útil do cliente.


O que você vai fazer

  • Prospectar produtores e organizadores de eventos (ativo e por indicação)
  • Apresentar nossa solução completa: ingressos online, PDV, controle de acesso, credenciamento, sistema de bar, cashless, pulseiras e estacionamento
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais (presenciais ou online) e elaborar propostas com nosso suporte
  • Negociar e fechar contratos seguindo nosso SLA de vendas

  • Identificar oportunidades de upsell (sistema de bar, credenciamento, pulseiras, totens, etc.)


Perfil que procuramos

  • Experiência ou rede de contatos em eventos, entretenimento, ticketing, casas noturnas, rodeios, festivais ou produção cultural (diferencial forte)
  • Perfil caçador : gosta de prospecção, não tem medo do \"não\" e celebra cada fechamento
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, postura comercial consultiva
  • Organização para registrar leads, eventos e contratos no nosso CRM/formulários
  • Autonomia e disciplina para trabalhar remotamente, sem chefe te cobrando todo dia
  • CNPJ ativo (MEI ou ME) ou disposição para abrir — formalizamos a parceria como PJ


Como você ganha (modelo de remuneração)

Trabalhamos com modelo de parceria comercial — sem salário fixo, 100% variável, sem teto e com recorrência . Você é remunerado pelo sucesso que gera.


- Comissão recorrente sobre vendas online (site)

  • % de cashback sobre o faturamento total das vendas online de cada evento que você trouxer
  • Recebe toda vez que aquele cliente fizer um evento conosco — não é venda única, é recorrência

- Comissão sobre serviços faturados

  • Alta % sobre o valor dos serviços prestados em fatura: ingressos impressos, cortesias, pulseiras, sistema de bar, credenciamento, controle de acesso, totens etc.


- Comissão sobre sistema de bar e cashless

  • Operações de bar (caixas, máquinas SmartPOS, cashless, totens) entram no cálculo da sua comissão recorrente — e esse é um mercado que vem crescendo muito


- Bônus por performance

  • Campanhas trimestrais e bônus de performance para top performers
  • Programa de aceleração para quem trouxer eventos de grande porte (acima de 5 mil ingressos ou contratos com recorrência mensal)

- Comissão por indicação

  • Indicou um produtor que fechou? Você ganha mesmo sem conduzir o processo todo


Exemplo prático: Um festival que vende ingressos online no site, com taxa, gera receita. Você recebe comissão de cashback sobre o faturamento bruto. Se for evento recorrente (anual), você recebe todo ano , sem precisar prospectar de novo.


O que oferecemos para você vender

  • Plataforma robusta, com 16+ anos de mercado e milhares de eventos realizados
  • Materiais comerciais prontos: apresentações, vídeos, fotos e cases de sucesso
  • Modelos de propostas e contratos por tipo de evento (com e sem advance/cachê)
  • Suporte técnico e operacional pré e pós-venda
  • Time de atendimento que te ajuda a fechar
  • Treinamento sobre produtos, precificação e SLA de vendas
  • Liberdade total de horário e local — você gerencia sua rotina

Formato da contratação

  • Parceria comercial PJ (autônomo com CNPJ)
  • Sem vínculo empregatício, sem CLT, sem exclusividade obrigatória de jornada
  • Contrato formal com cláusulas claras de comissionamento, confidencialidade e não concorrência

Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador de obras - Incorporação em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Oportunidade: Coordenador de Obras (Incorporação)

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento.

description:

Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate).
  • Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar).
  • Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade.
  • Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação.
  • Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários.
  • Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença.
  • Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança.
  • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional.
  • Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional.
  • Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento.
  • Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado.
  • Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos).
  • Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
  • Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
  • Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.
  • Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações.
  • Garantir bem-estar animal.
  • Atuar junto com fornecedores.

title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Specialist, Global ICSR em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety


Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities.
  • SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary.
  • Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management.
  • Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts.
  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.

Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Specialist, Global ICSR em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety


Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities.
  • SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary.
  • Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management.
  • Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts.
  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)- Banco de talentos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica).

O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe InDesign já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. A atividade diária principal será receber artes prontas das agências dos EUA para executar ajustes (no InDesign) conforme comentários (em inglês) feitos no PDF. Além disso, será necessário também montar facas especiais e fazer o envio dos arquivos para a gráfica.

Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas);
  • Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso.
  • Domínio dos software InDesign e illustrator;
  • Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 10h as 19h ou das 13h as 22h.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos WorkFront);

--

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veterinary Radiologist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.

This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.
